# JSON Link

> Local-first internationalization (i18n) spreadsheet studio and two-way disk synchronization suite with native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI coding agents.

JSON Link gives software teams, translators, and AI agents a unified, offline-capable interface to manage JSON, YAML, ARB, Android XML, iOS .strings, and Excel (.xlsx) localization bundles with zero server-side data leakage.

## Core Capabilities

- **In-Browser Local-First Engine**: Edits files directly on the local filesystem using the Web File System Access API without uploading private localization bundles to third-party cloud servers.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server**: Provides stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 tools for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code to read, batch translate, lint, and add localization keys autonomously.
- **End-to-End Client Encryption**: Encrypts shared project snapshots in browser memory using AES-GCM 256-bit with PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations) via Web Crypto API inside URL hash fragments.
- **ICU & Variable Preservation**: Preserves ICU MessageFormat pluralization syntax and `{variable}` placeholders across AI translations.
- **Developer Ecosystem**: Includes `@jsonlink/vite-plugin` for native Hot Module Replacement (HMR) of locale keys and `npx create-jsonlink` scaffolding.
